resources.string: Linking a number gives the bot full access to that WhatsApp account — its messages and the ability to send as you.\n\nOnly pair a number you own, and only type the code yourself in WhatsApp on that phone. Never enter a code someone else gave you, and never ask someone else to enter one for you.
Address of the pairing portal. HTTPS is required except for localhost.

A WebView shell for the pairing portal.

It is a debug-signed build, not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta. Pairing a number means the bot can read that account’s messages and act as the account holder; unofficial clients also risk the account being banned.

Change the portal address from the menu if you host your own copy.
